interface.name: aizome_remote_paint_manager_v1

description.summary: optional retained drawing for an application's own surface

interface.description: The compositor may ask an application to export the operations used to paint a surface. Ordinary Wayland buffers remain authoritative and are always committed. No remote viewer can execute application code or supply drawing commands through this producer protocol.

interface.name: aizome_remote_paint_surface_v1

description.summary: double-buffered retained paint accompanying wl_surface commits

interface.description: Publish a sealed memfd containing one version-1 Frame. Its size is bounded to 16 MiB. The frame accompanies the next wl_surface commit. A new enabled event requires a full repaint with a fresh asset dictionary; deltas refer only to assets sent since that full frame. Unsupported paints invalidate retained replay on the next commit; normal pixels remain available.

arg.name: enabled
arg.summary: zero disables export; nonzero requests a full repaint
